title: Two speakers, English, taking turns

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good morning. Did you get a chance to look at the delivery schedule?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I did. The first shipment leaves on Monday, and the second one on Thursday.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That works for us. Can the second one include the spare parts as well?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, I will add them to the order today and send you the updated invoice.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Perfect. Please copy the warehouse team on that email.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Will do. Anything else before we close?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: No, that is everything. Thank you for your help.
